unit: QA Upsert Matter / QA Append Actions column mapping
description: The harness's two Sheets writes use the production column mappings, matching Matters on matter_id and Actions on idempotency_key.
why_it_exists: Matching Actions on idempotency_key rather than action_id is what makes a re-run of the same plan idempotent while a genuinely new plan appends fresh rows. Recording the matching column is as important as recording the column list.
assertions: Matters status is written from matter_status, and owner_chat_id from chat_id - the field names differ between the item and the sheet.
created_at is preserved on an existing matter (existing_created_at) and only stamped fresh when is_new_matter is true; updated_at and last_activity_at are always re-stamped.
unmapped_facts_json defaults to the literal '{}' when absent, so the column is never written blank.
Actions matches on idempotency_key, so replaying an identical plan updates rather than duplicates, while a new plan stamp always appends.
convertFieldsToString is on and attemptToConvertTypes is off, so no value is silently retyped by the node.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "schema": not executed by harness/run.js.
